stripText.remove: (Four diagrams labelled A–D. A is a rounded cell with a small bud at the top (budding). B is an undivided irregular amoeboid cell. C is a rounded cell with a small bud (budding). D is a cell constricted in the middle into two equal halves, a figure-of-eight shape — binary fission.)

(Four slide sketches labelled I–IV. Slide I shows rounded yeast-type cells, one bearing a small attached bud. Slides II, III and IV all show irregular amoeboid cells with elongating/dividing nuclei (Amoeba binary fission), not rounded budding cells.)
